about: Shahan Ali is a developer from Burewala, Punjab, Pakistan. Online, he works as PROBOY. He builds web apps, WhatsApp bots, Shopify stores and AI tools.

He is currently an ICS student at Govt Graduate College Burewala. He also maintains ProBoy-MD, an open-source WhatsApp bot built with Node.js. His work covers full-stack websites, Shopify themes and tools that use Google Gemini.

faq.q: Is this Shahan Ali the same person as Shahan Ali Mohsin or Shahan Ali Jamil?
faq.a: No. This website belongs to Shahan Ali (PROBOY / proboy315 / shahan315), a software developer and ICS student in Burewala, Punjab, Pakistan. He is not affiliated with Shahan Ali Mohsin (the Indian motorsport racing driver) or Shahan Ali Jamil (the corporate executive associated with EcoPack).

faq.q: What services does Shahan Ali offer?
faq.a: Shahan Ali builds full-stack web apps with React and Node.js. He also develops WhatsApp bots, customizes Shopify stores with Liquid, and adds AI features using Google Gemini.

ProBoy-MD is an open-source WhatsApp bot by Shahan Ali. It uses Node.js and Baileys, a library for WhatsApp's multi-device connection. The repository lists 224 command files in nine categories; features that use other services may need extra setup.

faq.q: What credential did Shahan Ali earn in 2026?
faq.a: Shahan Ali earned a Certificate of Recognition for Google Gemini QuizOff 2026 (dated 19 July 2026), organised by CampusCrew and hosted on Unstop.

faq.q: How can I contact or hire Shahan Ali?
faq.a: Use the contact form at https://proboy.vercel.app/contact, email shahanali.dev@gmail.com or send a WhatsApp message to +92 326 1684315. You can also find his GitHub link on this site.
